title: Export data in CSV or JSON format
description: DataExporter defines the export() template method which calls formatHeader(), formatRow(), and formatFooter() in order. CSVExporter and JSONExporter each override the three hook methods to produce their format. The template method is final — only the hooks change between subclasses.
hints: export() calls formatHeader(), then formatRow() for each row, then formatFooter() — you don't change this
CSVExporter produces comma-separated rows; JSONExporter wraps everything in [ ] with {} per row
Collect the output in a StringBuilder inside export() and return it as a String
issues: Without the template method, the export loop is duplicated in every format class
Changes to the export sequence must be applied to every subclass individually
overallGoal: Use the Template Method pattern so the export algorithm lives once in the base class and only the formatting details vary between CSV and JSON.
goals: Create an abstract DataExporter base class with a final export() method that defines the algorithm
Declare abstract hook methods (e.g. getHeader(), formatRow(), getFooter()) for subclasses to fill in
Implement CSVExporter and JSONExporter by overriding only the hook methods
